verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents AI agents that auto-remediate level 1 alerts and escalate complex cases for human review. Humans can review and remediate cases, alerts and risks via the web app or API, set case decisions, and pull a case audit trail. Together these suggest an override path with preserved history, but nothing explicitly shows overriding an agent's auto-remediation or viewing its recorded rationale. Missing for 10: documented override of an AI auto-remediated decision, inspection of the agent's original evidence and rationale, explicit retention of the original decision alongside the override in the audit trail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
